reveal.title: Chronicle
reveal.text: A running log of what the hero kills, finds and sees, in Diablo II words.

reveal.title: Run timeline
reveal.text: The Chronicle now shows a tape of every expedition: where the hero went and what it cost.

reveal.title: Hero voice
reveal.text: The hero now speaks at milestones, and keeps a diary page for each: the first level-up, the first death and every first sight in the Codex. A mute switch silences the spoken line.

reveal.title: Pacts
reveal.text: The first Andariel kill taught the hero its first Pacts: bargains that make the run harder and pay the tally.

reveal.title: Pact of Nightmares
reveal.text: Baal fell in Normal. The Nightmare Pacts are open.

reveal.title: Minimap
reveal.text: New sense: a map of the area, with the hero on it.
reveal.teaser: Meet a new place, or reach level 2.

reveal.title: Enemy dots
reveal.text: New sense: monsters in range show as dots on the map.

reveal.title: Health bars and names
reveal.text: New sense: monsters you have met in the Codex show a name and a health bar.
reveal.teaser: Meet a monster; each kind opens once it is in the Codex.

reveal.title: Elite markers
reveal.text: New sense: champions and named bosses carry a ring and their mod names.
reveal.teaser: Meet a champion or a named boss.

reveal.title: Eye for loot
reveal.text: New sense: rare, unique, set and rune drops on the ground are marked.
reveal.teaser: Costs tally, or find a first drop.

reveal.title: Danger rating
reveal.text: New sense: a rating of the area from monster level, the hero's level and the elites in view.

reveal.title: Hero overlays
reveal.text: New sense: life and mana as numbers, resists and the mercenary.
reveal.teaser: Reach level 12 or meet an act boss.

reveal.title: Quest log
reveal.text: The quests the hero holds, each with its current objective and why the hero is going there.

reveal.title: Identify reveal
reveal.text: Magic and rare finds arrive as face-down cards. Flip a card to see what the item turned out to be: its quality, its colour and a sound.
reveal.teaser: Pick up a magic or rare item.

reveal.title: Unique and set cards
reveal.text: Unique, set and crafted finds now arrive as cards too.
reveal.teaser: Find your first unique or set item.

reveal.title: Risk meter
reveal.text: Before a boss the hero reads its own numbers (potions, life, kit and the route guard) and tells you ready, marginal or turn back, by the same lines it fights by.

reveal.title: Cain's notes
reveal.text: Cain's notes now keep a card for every kind of monster the hero has killed ten of: what it is, how it fights, what it drops and a veteran's tip.
reveal.teaser: Kill ten of one kind of monster.

reveal.title: Cain's notes: resistances
reveal.text: After fifty kills of one kind its card shows how well it resists each element, on every difficulty.
reveal.teaser: Kill fifty of one kind of monster.

reveal.title: Waypoint atlas
reveal.text: The atlas lights every waypoint the hero has taken and shows where it wants to go next.

reveal.title: Alerts and pings
reveal.text: The hero tells you when something happens: a unique drop, a boss kill, a level, a return to town, a Pact pause or a proposal waiting. Death and low life are always told.

reveal.title: Repair when an item breaks
reveal.text: The hero repairs its gear at the next town visit after something it wears breaks. Policy sheet, row Repair gear.

reveal.title: Repair every hour
reveal.text: The hero repairs its gear at a town visit once an hour. Policy sheet, row Repair gear.

reveal.title: Repair every half hour
reveal.text: The hero repairs its gear at a town visit every half hour. Policy sheet, row Repair gear.

reveal.title: Always repair
reveal.text: The hero repairs damaged gear at every town visit. Policy sheet, row Repair gear.

reveal.title: Order queue, first slot
reveal.text: One order may now wait behind the running one: give an order and the hero goes on to the next when it ends. A queue never overrides the hero's own guard and stops when the hero dies.

reveal.title: Order queue, second slot
reveal.text: A second order may wait in the queue.
reveal.teaser: Finish Kashya's or Charsi's quest, or buy it with tally.

reveal.title: Order queue, third slot
reveal.text: A third order may wait in the queue.
reveal.teaser: Rescue Deckard Cain, or buy it with tally.
